title: philadelphus lewisii var. californicus
intro: Philadelphus lewisii var. californicus, commonly known as California Mock Orange, is a deciduous shrub native to the western United States. This plant is used in herbal medicine and is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Philadelphus lewisii var. californicus include treating respiratory issues, such as colds and flu, and it has been traditionally used as an expectorant and antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
